visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails wearing a maroon sleeveless top walks away from the camera on a light-colored wooden walkway. The environment is an outdoor historical-style site with modern wooden and glass buildings and lush green trees above. (2) The girl pauses by a pond to watch a fish jump. A younger girl in a dark teal sleeveless top joins her, and they both walk towards an open pavilion decorated with blue-and-white batik fabrics. (3) In a workshop setting, an adult's hands guide the older girl's hands to place green leaves on a white fabric square positioned on a black block. The girl holds a metal hammer with a wooden handle. (4) Close-up shots show the younger girl in the teal shirt hitting a leaf-covered fabric with her hammer, guided by adult hands. The children focus intensely on the tapping motion. (5) The younger girl is presented with the final result—a white bookmark with green leaf prints. She holds it up, looking at it with a quiet, observant expression. The video ends with a pink background and an animated logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Bright acoustic guitar music begins. A cheerful adult female voice narrates in Mandarin, introducing the blue-dyeing workshop. (2) A light 'splash' sound is heard. A child's voice excitedly shouts 'Xiao yu!', signifying curiosity at the pond. (3) A distinct metallic 'clink' occurs as the first hammer strike hits the block. The narrator's tone is warm and instructive. (4) Rhythmic, percussive metallic tapping sounds continue steadily as the hammers are used. Occasional high-pitched child chatter overlays the steady acoustic background music. (5) A sharper 'ding' sound effect transitions the scene. The adult's voice rises in a positive contour, praising the finished work. (6) The music remains as a final celebratory bed, ending with a soft digital chime.
